title: 李开复·零一万物：中美都有空间胜出，穷国劳动力被取代谁来管？
speaker: Kai-Fu Lee

segments.en: Well, it's inevitable. It's the single question most media and people want to talk about.
segments.zh: 嗯，这不可避免。这是大多数媒体和人们最想谈的一个问题。

segments.en: And also the two strongest countries in the world are naturally going to face the two cities trap. But I think in reality, US will be ahead in many things, such as enterprise AI, making money, building breakthrough technologies, models, and China will be had in other things, maybe consumer applications, AI devices.
segments.zh: 而且世界上最强的两个国家自然会面临双城记式的竞争。但实际上我认为美国会在很多方面领先，比如企业级AI、变现、突破性技术和模型，而中国会在其他方面领先，也许是消费者应用、AI设备。

segments.en: So I think there will be plenty of room for both countries to win. What I worry about is the poor countries that don't create this giant GDP growth and have workforce that will slowly become replaced. That's the problem.
segments.zh: 所以我认为两国都有足够的空间胜出。我担心的是那些无法创造这种巨大GDP增长、劳动力将慢慢被取代的贫穷国家。那才是问题。

segments.en: In 20 seconds or so, do I need to be worried about profitability on the China side of AI?
segments.zh: 大约20秒时间，我需要担心中国AI的盈利能力吗？

segments.en: I think profitability is always a question. And for example, the large language models are open source, so hard to monetize. But my company, zero one, that AI, builds a product for the CEO, and we charge a reasonable price, and we expect to be profitable sometime next year.
segments.zh: 我认为盈利能力始终是个问题。比如大语言模型是开源的，所以很难变现。但我的公司零一万物为CEO打造产品，我们收取合理价格，预计明年某个时候实现盈利。
